definitions.F: released (A=1) and a modelled utility intersects the excavation envelope (U=1)
definitions.R_decision: 1 - P(U|A): conditional decision reliability in the simulated environment

uncertainty_set.note: filter-side set used by the robust policies P4-P6; P7 adds the swath alternative: the probability that a utility lies anywhere in the +-5 m swath

policy_label.B1_fusion_fixed: Standard Bayesian fusion, fixed 0.5 threshold, no abstention
policy_label.B2_1d_framework: Continuity-aware 1D filter with blind-cell rule (v1.0 framework)
policy_label.P5_robust_theta_struct: Robust over parameter set and structural alternatives
policy_label.P7_robust_swath: Robust, with the full-swath alternative (most conservative)

selftests.name: P(F), P(U|A), P(A) equal the v4 strikes/200, false_clearance and released
joint probability is the conditional risk times coverage
quality-adjusted rule equals the v4 proposed rule on the same inputs
score <= 1 releases exactly the segments the rule releases
expected-loss action moves from release to verify to restrict as the probability rises
power-duct release threshold equals pit cost over (strike cost - hold cost)
a random score gives a flat curve at the prevalence
a perfect score gives zero risk until the clean segments run out
risk-controlled level releases a set with conditional risk at or below the target
calibrated abstention releases only scores whose calibrated risk is at most alpha
variance decomposition recovers the known components (aleatory 1e-4, epistemic 4e-4)
Latin hypercube design has one point in every stratum of every parameter
surrogate Sobol estimator recovers the Ishigami first-order indices (0.314, 0.442, 0)
a simulated network is reproducible from its seed
the supremum over the uncertainty set is never below the nominal probability
reference check flags few corridors when the true parameters equal the assumed ones
reference check flags more corridors when the true soil is three times as lossy
